## Detailed Syllabus Overview

### 1. SAP MM (Materials Management) & S/4HANA Sourcing
- Enterprise Structure (Client, Company Code, Plant, Storage Location, Purchasing Org)
- Master Data (Material Master MM01/02/03, Business Partner BP, Purchasing Info Record ME11, Source List ME01)
- Purchasing Documents (Purchase Requisition ME51N, RFQ ME41, Purchase Order ME21N, Contracts ME31K)
- Inventory Management (Goods Receipt MIGO with movement type 101, Goods Issue, Transfer Postings, Stock Overview MMBE/MB52)
- Physical Inventory & Cycle Counting (MI01, MI04, MI07)
- Valuation & Account Determination (OBYC configuration and G/L mapping with FI)
- Logistics Invoice Verification (MIRO, 3-way match, price variances, credit memos)
- S/4HANA Fiori Applications and Migration strategies

### 2. SAP HANA Architecture & Modeling
- In-Memory Database Architecture (Row store vs Column store, persistence layer, MVCC)
- Calculation Views (Dimension, Cube, Star Join, Aggregations, Calculated Columns, Input Parameters)
- CDS Views (Core Data Services, Virtual Data Models)
- ABAP for HANA (AMDP - ABAP Managed Database Procedures)
- Data Provisioning (SAP Landscape Transformation SLT, Smart Data Integration SDI)
- S/4HANA Migration paths (Greenfield, Brownfield, SUM with DMO)

### 3. SAP FI (Financial Accounting)
- Financial Enterprise Structure (Company Code, Chart of Accounts, Fiscal Year Variant)
- General Ledger Accounting (FI-GL, Document Types, Number Ranges, Posting Keys)
- Accounts Payable (FI-AP, Business Partner, Automatic Payment Program F110, TDS/Withholding Tax)
- Accounts Receivable (FI-AR, Customer Master, Dunning procedures, Billing Integration SD-FI)
- Asset Accounting (FI-AA, Asset Classes, Depreciation Keys, Year-End Closing)
- S/4HANA Universal Journal (ACDOCA table architecture and financial closing)
